purpose: Original offline SDF edge coverage; no narrowing or compatibility patches.

capture.normalization: Shared fixed capture_geometry.json rectangle; no image scaling or registration. Label baselines use source font ascent. Labels also move (-1.5, +0.5) font pixels (Y up), scaled by the requested screen scale, to remove legacy horizontal padding and corner-sampling offsets.
capture.sampling: Test-only vertex shader magnifies geometry after the unmodified renderer computes smoothing. The fragment shader and compiler are byte-for-byte 1.13.1.
capture.configurations: The six offline glyph-bank captures are shared across four current configurations. This single H has no rich-text markup or shaping; offline banks use legacy layout.
capture.origin_adjustment_reason: 1.13.1 Fontc.GetFontMapPadding adds one horizontal pixel without shifting the stored left bearing; DistanceFieldGenerator.render samples integer pixel coordinates. Native generation uses the padded bitmap origin and pixel centers. These source conventions imply (-1 - 0.5, +0.5), independently of captured pixels.

-- Fixed test projection and the normal builtin font materials.
function init(self)
    self.labels = render.predicate({"tile"})
    self.gui = render.predicate({"gui"})
    self.clear = { [graphics.BUFFER_TYPE_COLOR0_BIT] = vmath.vector4(0, 0, 0, 1),
                   [graphics.BUFFER_TYPE_DEPTH_BIT] = 1, [graphics.BUFFER_TYPE_STENCIL_BIT] = 0 }
    self.projection = vmath.matrix4_orthographic(0, 960, 0, 2048, -1, 1)
    self.target = render.render_target({
        [graphics.BUFFER_TYPE_COLOR0_BIT] = { format = graphics.TEXTURE_FORMAT_RGBA, width = 960, height = 2048,
            min_filter = graphics.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST, mag_filter = graphics.TEXTURE_FILTER_NEAREST },
        [graphics.BUFFER_TYPE_DEPTH_BIT] = { format = graphics.TEXTURE_FORMAT_DEPTH, width = 960, height = 2048 },
        [graphics.BUFFER_TYPE_STENCIL_BIT] = { format = graphics.TEXTURE_FORMAT_STENCIL, width = 960, height = 2048 }
    })
end

function update(self)
    -- Draw and capture a dedicated texture, independent of the host window.
    render_test.set_render_target(self.target)
    render.set_render_target(self.target)
    render.set_depth_mask(true)
    render.set_stencil_mask(0xff)
    render.clear(self.clear)
    render.set_viewport(0, 0, 960, 2048)
    render.set_view(vmath.matrix4())
    render.set_projection(self.projection)
    render.set_depth_mask(false)
    render.disable_state(graphics.STATE_DEPTH_TEST)
    render.disable_state(graphics.STATE_CULL_FACE)
    render.enable_state(graphics.STATE_BLEND)
    render.set_blend_func(graphics.BLEND_FACTOR_SRC_ALPHA, graphics.BLEND_FACTOR_ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA)
    render.draw(self.labels)
    render.enable_state(graphics.STATE_STENCIL_TEST)
    render.draw(self.gui)
    render.disable_state(graphics.STATE_STENCIL_TEST)
    render.disable_state(graphics.STATE_BLEND)
    -- Capture the actual queued text data before the normal frame cleanup.
    render_test.flush_and_snapshot()
end
fixture_sources.bootstrap/loader.script:
local cases = {"#ttf_sdf_single_edge_half","#ttf_sdf_single_edge_one","#ttf_sdf_single_edge_two","#otf_sdf_single_edge_half","#otf_sdf_single_edge_one","#otf_sdf_single_edge_two"}

local function next_case(self)
    self.index = self.index + 1
    if self.index > #cases then
        msg.post("@system:", "exit", {code=0})
        return
    end
    self.proxy = cases[self.index]
    msg.post(self.proxy, "async_load")
end
function init(self)
    self.index = 0
    next_case(self)
end
function on_message(self, id, message, sender)
    if id == hash("proxy_loaded") then
        msg.post(sender, "init")
        msg.post(sender, "enable")
    elseif id == hash("case_done") then
        msg.post(self.proxy, "disable")
        msg.post(self.proxy, "final")
        msg.post(self.proxy, "unload")
    elseif id == hash("proxy_unloaded") then
        next_case(self)
    end
end
